question: Does Fzd2 sustain AF1 fibroblast support of an AT2 pool capable of mature alveolar repair more strongly than Fzd1?
working_hypothesis: Fzd2 is more necessary than Fzd1 for AF1 fibroblasts to maintain AT2 cells that subsequently produce mature alveolar descendants.
previous_question: Does Fzd2, more than Fzd1, sustain AF1 fibroblast support of AT2-derived alveolar repair?
primary_outcome_retained: absolute lineage-linked mature AT2-descendant output per starting epithelial population, with prospectively defined identity and functional criteria; original H1 endpoint retained
